import email

import ssl
from pathlib import Path

host = 'node1'
password = [REDACTED]
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.check_hostname = False
ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
client = imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(host, 993, ssl_context=ctx)
status, _ = client.login('archive', password)
assert status == 'OK', status
status, count = client.select('INBOX', readonly=True)
assert status == 'OK', status
assert int(count[0]) == 2, count
status, ids = client.search(None, 'ALL')
assert status == 'OK', status
expected = {
    '<one@branch.test>': ('Shipment arrived.', True),
    '<two@branch.test>': ('Shipment departed.', False),
}
seen = {}
for seq in ids[0].split():
    status, data = client.fetch(seq, '(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])')
    assert status == 'OK', (seq, status)
    meta, raw = next(item for item in data if isinstance(item, tuple))
    flags = imaplib.ParseFlags(meta)
    msg = email.message_from_bytes(raw, policy=email.policy.default)
    message_id = msg['Message-ID']

assert seen == expected, (seen, expected)
status, _ = client.logout()
assert status == 'BYE', status
